Sharad
London, United Kingdom8 contributions

Absolutely botched up
Mar 2019 • Couples
We are vegans and had called the restaurant in advance of our dietary restrictions. They said they would be happy to cater for us without any issues. However, when we arrived there was also a large tour group being served. Our customised menu was on the table already which really impressed us. Things went downhill from then. It took absolute ages to get our appetiser. After that the soup arrived after about 20 minutes of the appetiser. The main course with vegetable rice arrived another 30 minutes from the soup. As we were eating we noticed a piece of chicken alongside the tofu. Appalled, we called the waiter to complain. He simply said sorry and took the serving bowl back to the kitchen. A little later we found another small chunk of meat in the sautéed vegetables. Disgusted and angry I called for the manager. When she arrived she apologised and said this was because the chef was very busy serving a large group! She offered us free coffee to make up for this huge mistake. We declined her offer. How can a restaurant of this reputation make such a critical mistake. What if someone with nut allergy had asked for meal without nuts and the chef was careless enough to put nuts in the meal. Such a careless mistake can cost a establishment their trading licence. I will never be visiting this restaurant ever again. Even a 1 star review seems too generous.
